_comment: Optional extra patterns, each validated against the catastrophic-backtracking screen and tested for false positives. Copy the entries you want into the "patterns" array of your redact-rules.json. Category names are free-form and appear in the label, e.g. [PII:secret:a1b2...].

patterns.name: aws-access-key
patterns._why: AWS access key IDs (AKIA/ASIA/AROA/AIDA + 16 chars).

patterns.name: github-token
patterns._why: GitHub personal access, OAuth and server tokens.

patterns.name: slack-token
patterns._why: Slack bot, user and app tokens.

patterns.name: private-key-block
patterns._why: The header line of any private key block.

patterns.name: jwt
patterns._why: JSON Web Tokens.

patterns.name: bearer-token
patterns._why: Authorization: Bearer headers pasted into prompts or tool output.

patterns.name: generic-api-key-assignment
patterns._why: api_key/secret_key/access_token/client_secret assignments, any provider. Needs 16+ chars so placeholders survive.

patterns.name: openai-key
patterns._why: OpenAI secret keys, including sk-proj- and sk-svcacct-.

patterns.name: anthropic-key
patterns._why: Anthropic API keys.

patterns.name: stripe-key
patterns._why: Stripe secret, publishable and restricted keys, live or test.

patterns.name: google-api-key
patterns._why: Google and Firebase API keys.

patterns.name: sendgrid-key
patterns._why: SendGrid API keys.

patterns.name: npm-token
patterns._why: npm automation and publish tokens.

patterns.name: huggingface-token
patterns._why: Hugging Face access tokens.

patterns.name: connection-string-password
patterns._why: Database URLs with an inline password. Matches the credentials only, so the host stays readable.

patterns.name: credit-card
patterns._why: Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover, by prefix and length.

patterns.name: iban
patterns._why: International bank account numbers.

patterns.name: india-aadhaar
patterns._why: Aadhaar numbers (12 digits, never starting 0 or 1).

patterns.name: india-pan
patterns._why: Indian Permanent Account Number.

patterns.name: us-ssn
patterns._why: US Social Security numbers, excluding never-issued ranges.
